uutiset.t: Three killed and dozens missing after fire at Indonesian factory
uutiset.s: At least three people were killed and many more feared dead after a fire at a confectionary factory.

uutiset.t: Russia-bound ship still on fire after attack in Gulf of Finland
uutiset.s: Finnish defence forces say that Ukraine was likely behind the drone attack on the vessel.

uutiset.t: South Korea education minister resigns over exam cheating scandal
uutiset.s: Choi Kyo-jin admits last-minute measures to stop AI-assisted cheating during the college entrance exam caused chaos.

uutiset.t: Italian jeweller and businessman Paolo Bulgari dies aged 89
uutiset.s: In a statement to Italian media, his family remember him as "the greatest jeweller of our time".

uutiset.t: Mexican drug lord on FBI's 10 most wanted list arrested in shoot-out
uutiset.s: Fausto Isidro "Chapo Idisro" Meza Flores, who is accused of drug trafficking and torture, is detained after gun fight with authorities.

uutiset.t: FBI reportedly investigating apparent hack of its criminal database
uutiset.s: The National Crime Information Center database is used by federal and local law enforcement to share information.

uutiset.t: Nigerian youth have shown their power in the past - why aren't they shaping this election?
uutiset.s: Fewer young people have registered to vote in next year's election than in 2023 - are young people losing faith in democracy?

uutiset.t: How a teen gamer and his mother helped rescue a missing girl
uutiset.s: When 16-year-old Landon Tresp met a teenage girl in an online game, it led to him and his mother helping the FBI rescue her from kidnapping.

uutiset.t: Lock of former US President George Washington's hair sells for $4,000
uutiset.s: The hair was given as a sign of friendship shortly before Washington's death in 1799, according to a descendent of its former owner.

uutiset.t: Zelensky says Crimean Bridge strikes 'fair response' as he meets UK's Streeting
uutiset.s: Ukraine's president says Kyiv acted after 109 separate Russian aerial attacks on bridges in Ukraine.

uutiset.t: Denmark accuses Russia of plotting to assassinate US-Ukrainian rapper
uutiset.s: The Russian embassy in Denmark has denied the allegation, which has led to Russia's defence attaché being expelled.

uutiset.t: Deal with EU not dependent on tuition fees agreement, Miliband says
uutiset.s: Brussels sources had previously suggested the bloc might not apply the wider deal until fees were lowered for EU students in Britain.

uutiset.t: Zelensky says Putin is a 'killer' after Trump calls Russian leader a friend
uutiset.s: Earlier this week, Trump greeted Putin ahead of a meeting in China and said the pair have a "great relationship".

uutiset.t: Trafalgar Square Christmas tree felled in Norway
uutiset.s: The 21m tree is Oslo’s annual thank you for Britain’s support during World War Two.

uutiset.t: Man convicted of starting Palisades fire in Los Angeles
uutiset.s: The 30-year-old LA resident was convicted of arson leading to wildfires that killed 12 people and destroyed more than 6,800 buildings.
